summary: Directional flow-shadow hydrology, seam-safe river/lake/cave masks, map-control profile drift guards, and stronger protobuf parser validation.

core.name: Directional flow-shadow hydrology
core.description: Blend hydrology with flow-aware smoothing and downhill bias so caves/rivers/lakes stay stitched across chunk seams.

core.name: World-map profile drift guard
core.description: Detect and regenerate hashed world-map control profiles when world.json changes on server or StreamingAssets.

core.name: Parser round-trip guard
core.description: Validate EnhancedMinecraftProtocol parsers and descriptors round-trip against the registry to catch stale using bindings.

content.name: River seam flow shadow
content.description: Gradient-aware river pressure with seam guards and tributary boosts to keep channels continuous.

content.name: Wetland seam guard
content.description: Shoreline jitter, hydrology-gradient dampening, and flow-shadowed lake basins with downhill outflows.

content.name: Flow-resilient caves
content.description: Flow-gradient penalties and seam-aware stability smoothing to reduce flooded or collapsing caves.

utilities.name: Config parity
utilities.description: Keep world/map-control JSON synchronized between server config and StreamingAssets with hashes.

utilities.name: Protobuf validation
utilities.description: Run parser/descriptor round-trip checks via ProtocolStandardization and verify_protobuf.ps1.

utilities.name: Build + smoke
utilities.description: dotnet build for SharedProtocol/GameServer and protobuf smoke validation.
